profile.headline: Full-Stack Software Engineer | React 19 · TypeScript · Node · Docker | Design systems, accessibility, and AI-assisted development at enterprise scale
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary:
My core principles of development: product knowledge, user needs, and company bottom line. I learn the business before I write the code — who uses the product, what it costs the company when it breaks, and what sales is promising. That context is what makes the technical calls obvious.

Full-stack engineer on Valcom's enterprise communications platform — the system that carries emergency notification and mass communication for schools, hospitals, and industrial sites. Three things I've owned there:

Design system modernization — Led the frontend overhaul that repositioned the product beyond its K-12 origins into healthcare, commercial, and industrial markets. Ran a structured evaluation against CSS Modules, Sass, and Bootstrap, then negotiated buy-in from two teams on competing stacks to standardize on Tailwind. Rebuilt ~150 components through a React 17 → 19 upgrade to WCAG 2.2 AA.

Containerization — Architected the multi-service Docker stack that replaced hand-scripted, site-by-site installation with a single Compose-defined deployment. Atomic image-based upgrades and database-backed rollbacks in place of the prior delete-and-reinstall model — the platform's first repeatable deployment story.

AI-assisted development — Authored 24 Claude Skills and 3 Python hooks that constrain AI-assisted development against our CI/CD requirements, including a per-file checkpoint that blocks progression until generated code passes. Built for the whole engineering org, not just my own workflow.

Before Valcom I taught web development and cybersecurity at Coding Dojo — curriculum design, lecture delivery, and code review for cohorts of 50+.

TypeScript · React 19 · Node.js · Express · PostgreSQL · Python · Docker · RabbitMQ · Playwright · Vitest · WCAG 2.2 AA · OWASP

positions.title: Software Engineer, Full-Stack
positions.description:
• Increased engineering output company-wide by authoring 24 Claude Skills and 3 Python hooks that constrain AI-assisted development — including a per-file checkpoint that blocks progression until generated code meets CI/CD requirements. Made AI-assisted development usable by engineers beyond the early adopters.

• Standardized Tailwind CSS as the organization-wide frontend standard, reducing single points of failure and improving cross-team mobility. Ran a structured evaluation against CSS Modules, Sass, and Bootstrap, then negotiated buy-in across two teams on competing stacks before migration began.

• Helped reposition Valcom's enterprise product for 3+ new markets beyond its original K-12 base by initiating and shaping the company-wide style guide through modernization wireframes, customer research, and sales feedback.

• Lowered installation and maintenance costs by architecting the multi-service Docker stack that replaced a hand-scripted installation with a single Compose-defined deployment. Enabled atomic image-based upgrades and database-backed rollbacks in place of delete-and-reinstall.

positions.title: Programming & Cybersecurity Instructor
positions.description: Authored curriculum tracks for web development and cybersecurity for cohorts of 50+ students. Responsible for full learning arc: syllabus design, lecture delivery, code review, and iterating material cohort-over-cohort based on graduation outcomes. Left a legacy of successful and effective strategies, exercises, and data to improve future cohorts throughout the company.
